notes.subject: ⟨u⟩ · ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew yɛlɛmali-fɔlɔw tɛ ye; baarakɛla-w (u) ni Moshe (a) bɛ fara a kan kuma in tiɲɛnira

notes.subject: רוחו — a finyɛ
notes.rationale: Sɛbɛnni-kɔrɔyɔrɔw fara ɲɔgɔn kan: finyɛ min don Moshe ta (KJV, JPS) walima Yawe ta (JPS nɔ)</br> — kalanbaga fɔlɔw ma Yawe ka finyɛ 'wuyi' se, o la Moshe ta de tiɲɛnira</br>

notes.subject: ויבטא
notes.rationale: 'nununi la fɔli' — Heburukan bɛ fɔ kuma-babali-bɛɛ ta cogo la; daɲɛ in ye cogo-juguw ta daɲɛ ye

translation: Sabu ⟨u⟩ ye ⟨a⟩ finyɛ wuyi, n'a ye kuma fɔ nununi la ni ⟨a⟩ da ye.

tokens.gloss: a ye kuma fɔ nununi la
